# `ifnull`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
ifnull(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns `expr2` if `expr1` is null, or `expr1` otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- ifnull, example 1
> SELECT ifnull(NULL, array('2'));
["2"]
```
